hero_subhead: Transform your home with flawless paintwork and decoration. Free quotes, professional finish, on time, every time.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Sheffield
services_subhead: From interior refreshes to full exterior repaints, we handle every job with attention to detail and professional workmanship.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Transform your rooms with expert interior painting, wallpapering, and feature walls. We protect your furniture, prepare surfaces properly, and deliver a flawless finish that lasts.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weatherproof and revitalise your home's exterior. We use trade-grade exterior paints and primers designed to withstand Sheffield's climate, with prep work that ensures long-lasting protection.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Professional wallpaper hanging for feature walls, full rooms, or commercial spaces. Pattern matching, clean removal of old paper, and expert finishing on all wall types.

services.title: Woodwork & Skirting Painting
services.desc: Precision painting of skirting boards, doors, frames, and trim. We sand, prime, and apply multiple coats to create smooth, durable finishes that enhance your décor.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Tiling Prep
services.desc: Professional surface preparation and specialist paint application for high-moisture areas. We use products rated for kitchens and bathrooms to resist steam and mildew.

services.title: Commercial & Retail Decoration
services.desc: Quick turnaround painting for shops, offices, and hospitality spaces. We work around your trading hours and deliver professional results that impress clients and staff.

about_pullquote: I do the work I'd want done in my own home—no shortcuts, no mess.
about_para_1: Sami's Painting and Decorating has been transforming homes and businesses across Sheffield and Rotherham for over 15 years. What started as one person with a passion for quality finishes has grown into a trusted local name, completing thousands of interior and exterior projects along the way. Every job—whether a single room refresh or a full commercial repaint—receives the same meticulous attention to detail.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on reliability, honest quotes, and work we're proud to stand behind. We listen to what you want, prepare surfaces properly, and use quality materials chosen for durability, not just cost. Customers return to us repeatedly because we treat every home and every business like it matters—because it does.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About Sami's Work

reviews.text: Sami repainted our lounge and hallway during lockdown. He was really professional—covered all the furniture, didn't make a mess, and the finish is immaculate. Better than we expected, and he finished on time. Will definitely use him again.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Had our kitchen cupboards and doors repainted. Sami stripped them down properly, filled and sanded everything, and applied several coats. They look like new. Great attention to detail and he tided up every day. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Exterior of the house needed doing badly. Sami quoted fairly, explained what he'd do, and got the work done in good time despite the weather. Quality job, professional throughout. Fair price and no hassle. Top work.
reviews.author: Michael T.
